_: Accessories priced in the February 1952 Bolex retail price list.
Source: Bolex Catalog, Feb 1952 (Pacific Rim rl/01775), pages 21 and
22. An image-only scan, OCR'd and then read by eye, because the
prices are the whole point and OCR gets digits wrong.
This is the earliest pricing the archive has, and it corroborates
Michael in three places: he put the L-8 cable release at $4.90 and the
list says $4.90; he dated the filter slot modification from a 1952
catalogue, and this is that catalogue; he could date the Titler only
as far back as a September 1950 price list, and here it is again.

eye-level-focus.note: Still $37.75 in the 1965 dealer list, thirteen years later, where it is code REFTU.

prismatic-focuser.note: Still $19.75 in the 1965 dealer list, where it is code CADIL and called the new type.

h-cable-release.note: The list prices both lengths Michael describes: 18in at $6.50 and 40in at $7.50.

l-8-cable-release.note: Exactly the price Michael gives for it, from his own reading of a late 1940s source.

paillard-trifilm-splicer.note: Michael records it at $22.71 in 1948. By February 1952 it is $14.95, so the price came down.

bolex-titler.note: The same list prices the basic equipment alone at $154.50 and an accessory kit at $141.00.

bolex-filterslot-modification.asPrinted: Filter Slot Installation with 6 Filter holders in leather case
bolex-filterslot-modification.note: This is the 1952 catalogue Michael cites for the modification.

octameter.note: With $18.00 credited back if the Trifocal Viewfinder was returned, which is what the Octameter replaced.

h-1.note: The archive has two H-1 case entries, this one and a 1950s revision. The list says only H-1, so the price is attached to the original design.

h-2-zipper.note: The list says only H-2. This is the archive's only plain H-2 entry.
